findings.title: Duplicated fetch-with-auth-headers logic across API clients
findings.note: Both build identical Authorization+X-Retry headers and repeat the fetch/json/try-catch shape, differing in BASE, token var, timeout, and error handling. Leads mark this pair change-coupled (shared=4, ratio=0.889); error handling already drifted (see fbf5b36).

looks_bad_but_fine.why: legacyFormat calls formatMoney and post-processes the string rather than reimplementing formatting logic; not a duplicate, just a thin deprecated wrapper.
